title: Meta brings its Muse AI assistant directly into Instagram DMs
lede: Instagram users can now chat with Meta's Muse agent in a DM thread, sharing posts with it and asking it to act on them without opening the separate Muse app.

points: Muse can add context on a post, place or product, or catch a user up on DM conversations they missed.
A shared post can trigger an action, such as adding a coffee shop to a trip itinerary or finding a shoe deal.
Instagram conversations with Muse also appear as a side chat in the Muse app.
Saving a post now prompts Muse to sort it into Collections, or turn recipe, travel and fashion posts into lists, itineraries and outfit ideas.
DM access rolls out on iOS and Android in the US, Canada, Mexico, Japan and Singapore; the save prompt is US and Canada only.

sections.text: Meta says Muse shares, sends or publishes nothing without approval and can forget information or undo actions on request, an approval model for an agent acting inside a social app.
